basis: Astra experiment-card scoring; GT files unchanged
strictPhysicalMatch: For the same observable object class, a valid normalized box must contain exactly one preGT object center; that GT center must be contained by exactly one predicted box of that class. Invalid/no box, multiple center/box candidates remain unmatched or ambiguous. Matching never uses predicted values. A box-center distance is diagnostic only, not permission to shift boxes.
correspondenceAlongsideStrict: If strict boxes fail, a separate reviewer relative-row/column or named photograph-row correspondence may be reported only when the visible spatial arrangement/object identity unambiguously establishes it without using predicted values. Record the justification and keep separate from strict matches. Never silently shift boxes or optimize matching to correct values.

catan.buildingsRoads: visible preGT inventory, uncertainty retained; no exact topology score

falsePositives: Only independently identifiable non-game objects, duplicate same physical object, or objects in confirmed empty regions are confirmed false positives. Unmatched output alone is not necessarily hallucination.
inference: One photo/arm/game; task+output-contract jointly vary. B is diagnostic raw observation, not app schema/save success. No generic accuracy claim.
